name: thinkrail
description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
one_liner: A code editor built around an AI coding assistant that gives the AI its own isolated workspace per task, keeps a running project plan, and helps you turn finished work into a pull request.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small software agency who wants every developer's AI-assisted work to follow the same reviewable process without buying a bigger IDE license.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes all client projects on it so every AI-written change arrives as an isolated, reviewable branch instead of a messy direct edit.
A solo contractor runs several AI coding sessions in parallel on different client repos from one tool instead of juggling terminal windows.
A team lead uses the shared living-spec feature to keep a junior developer's AI assistant from losing context on a long-running project.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'set up your team on AI-assisted development' consulting package built around configuring it and training developers on the workflow.
Build and sell project-specific skill packs or SPEC.md templates for common frameworks that plug into it.

steal_this: It's a free developer tool, not a product you resell as-is — the fastest weekend move is packaging a half-day 'AI dev workflow setup' consulting session around it for a client team.
